HARDWARE / ELECTRONICS / REPAIR WORKING DOMAIN — v2.0

PERSONAL WORKSPACE SHOULD RETAIN: • ESP8266 / Wemos D1 and ESP32 work. •
Arduino and I2C expansion. • PCF8574, relays, DHT11, analog soil sensors
and sensor multiplexing/polling questions. • Raspberry Pi /
small-computer / NAS / automation experiments. • HomeKit, Matter, Home
Assistant and local-network integration. • 12 V / 24 V lighting, pumps
and control. • solar PV, batteries, MPPT/inverters and small off-grid
systems. • wiring, pinouts, power budgets, voltage/current compatibility
and protection. • repair/troubleshooting history and measured evidence.
• BOMs, substitutions, suppliers and cost constraints. • compile errors,
firmware versions and regression evidence.

SPECIALIST FLOW: IDENTIFY DEVICE → CAPTURE SYMPTOMS → SAFETY CLASSIFY →
INVENTORY COMPONENTS → READ DATASHEETS/SOURCES → MEASURE → HYPOTHESIZE →
TEST NON-DESTRUCTIVELY → REPAIR/REPLACE → VERIFY → DOCUMENT.

Electrical/mains/high-energy work requires explicit safety boundaries
and must distinguish advice from verified field measurements.
